status: demonstration written by engineering from dated public sources and the pilot's records; no experiment has run and no benefit is realized or claimed
shape_note: Candidate fields follow the local AgentBriefs prototype (design/prototypes/agentbriefs): id, title, kind, label and ready. This is a demonstration record, not a registered contract.
evidence_floor: A candidate is offered only with at least one dated source and an experiment with a baseline, a metric and an acceptance rule. Anything else is withheld with its reason and raises no alert.

observations.fact: 1.2.3 (2026-08-16) shipped pull request 680 on backslash round trips; 1.2.4 (2026-10-01) fixed 663 and 700
no pilot run changed the library within 20 requests; two opened parser.py; three spent 6 to 16 of 20 tool calls on shell heredocs
the test workflow covers 3.10 to 3.14, 3.14t and PyPy 3.11; classifiers stop at 3.14
observations.source: .github/workflows/test.yml at a565c2cc and the PyPI classifiers

candidates.title: Property-based round-trip tests for the writer and the parser
candidates.label: Experimental fit

estimated_benefit.statement: a set_key/get_key round-trip property would have caught the defect that pull request 680 fixed and may catch the next one

experiment.treatment: generated values with backslashes, quotes, #, $, spaces, tabs and line breaks in the always, auto and never quote modes, each followed by a sentinel key
experiment.acceptance: finds the backslash failure on v1.2.2, and every v1.2.4 failure is a real defect or documented behaviour

candidates.title: A conformance table against two other .env readers
candidates.label: Experimental fit

evidence.fact: util.parseEnv added in v21.7.0 and v20.12.0; no longer experimental since v24.10.0 and v22.21.0
python-dotenv expects a='${b}' to expand b
agent MCP servers parse or compare .env files with their own code, such as EnvSync-LE (updated 2026-10-07)

estimated_benefit.statement: a published agreement table would spare users who share one .env file across Python, Node and Compose some silent surprises

experiment.treatment: 60 fixtures through dotenv_values, util.parseEnv and docker compose config
experiment.metric: disagreements traced to an upstream documentation line
experiment.acceptance: at least three disagreements, each traced to a source
experiment.effects: local processes only; nothing published without the maintainers

candidates.title: Add Python 3.15 to the test matrix
candidates.label: Maintenance

estimated_benefit.statement: users learn early whether 3.15 works, at the cost of one more matrix job

experiment.acceptance: passes, or every failure is reported upstream

withheld.title: A model that repairs malformed .env files while loading
